The user is reporting a bug: after switching to a substitute teacher (代課老師), the course management (課程管理) still shows the original teacher, but the calendar/schedule (行事曆/課表) is correct.

They want me to follow the bug-fix-plan workflow to investigate, list root cause candidates and their verification methods, without changing code.

Let me first read the bug-fix-plan rule, then the alltrue-system rule to understand the system, and the relevant plan files.
